name: Notre Dame Paris front facade lower
title: File:Notre Dame Paris front facade lower.jpg
author: Benh LIEU SONG
description: Lower part of the front façade of the Notre-Dame Cathedral, in Paris, at night. On the upper part, the 28 kings of Judea and Israel. On the lower part, from left to right, the portal of the Virgin, the portal of the Last Judgement, and the portal of Saint-Anne. This picture is a mosaic of 12 photos (4x3) taken with a Canon EOS 400D+EF-S 17-55mm f/2.8 IS, at 55mm, f/8.0, 6 sec and ISO 100. Stitching was done with Hugin and Enblend.
note: Resized photographic source; presentation may crop or desaturate the image.
